title: CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #7 OPERATION PINE SOOT OPEN
lines: 01 CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #7 OPERATION PINE SOOT OPEN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 2-10
SEASON DETAILS: During the season, players can combine different "Contracts" to clear stages, complete challenges, improve level evaluation, and collect "Contract Bounty" and "Operation Agreement."
- "Contract Bounty" can be used to redeem rewards in "Secret Sanctuary."
- "Operation Agreement" can be used to unlock more Contingency Contract contents.
CROSS-SEASON " SECRET SANCTUARY" OPEN
- Cross-Season Permanent Trade Center New Arrivals:
0011 Collection - Healing Hand, Evil Heart for Aak
Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics - Legacy for Siege (Re-edition)
Season #7 Furniture – Pine Soot Pennant
- Season #7 Special Trade Center Supplies: Elite Materials, LMD, Furniture Parts, Battle Records, Chips, etc.
NOTE:
- You do not need Sanity to play Contingency Contract stages.
- You need a certain number of completed Contracts to unlock some other Contracts. Please note that the number of completed Contracts DOES NOT EQUAL to Contingency Level.

- Compared with Season #6, Season #7 still has 8 sites in total, but has replaced 2 sites from the previous Season. There will be a new Rotating Site and a new Permanent Site, and the Permanent Site from last Season will be added into Rotating Sites. During the season, there will be 1 Permanent Site and 7 Rotating Sites (rotating daily) for you to challenge. (The first Rotating Site's rotation time and its corresponding challenges on the first day of the event will be extended by 1 day.)
- Several new Contracts and challenges will be added to the Season's Permanent Site on June 16, 2022, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- After Season #7 ends, the unused Contract Bounty will be retained.
- After Season #7 ends, all the Operation Agreements you have collected this season will be automatically converted into Operation Pine Soot Supplies. The ratio is 1:1.
- During Season #7, you will receive Credits if your Support Units have helped others in clearing their Contingency Contract stages.
- During Season #7, players can obtain Season #7 Engraved Medal Set by achieving related goals.
02 TARGETED OPERATOR HEADHUNTING OPEN: JOINT OPERATION
DETAILS: During the event, the Targeted Operator Headhunting, "Joint Operation", opens and ONLY the following Operators will appear in the 6* and 5* Operator List of this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Phantom / Saga / Schwarz / Surtr
★★★★★: Ayerscarpe / April / Flint / Meteorite / Beeswax / Iris
03 SUPPLIES & CHIPS EVERYDAY ACCESS
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies and Chips stay open during the period above.
